scope: Primary-source review and proposed deterministic mathematical specification. This file does not assert implementation or empirical calibration.
configuration_disclosure: No private conversation, credentials, or internal model configuration is included.

sources.title: Beyond Expected Goals
sources.access_status: Author-uploaded full-text HTML read; original Sloan PDF URL was inaccessible in this review.
supports: Off-ball positioning can be valued even without an actual reception.
Separate control, transition and scoring components.
The original player arrival description includes acceleration to a maximum speed.
The PPCF treatment does not explicitly model blocked passes along the whole path.
does_not_support: A calibrated interpretation of the demo's hand-built score.
Equating the Laurie implementation to the full original model.
Using target-only pitch control as complete ground-pass interception analysis.

sources.title: Physics-Based Modeling of Pass Probabilities in Soccer
supports: Moving-ball trajectory interception and time-to-control with competing control accumulation.
Need for fitted statistical parameters to interpret the output as a pass probability.
Hypothetical passes with stipulated kick parameters.
Published velocity estimation averages the first 0.4 seconds after release.
does_not_support: Transferring its reported accuracy to synthetic uncalibrated heuristics.
Treating the post-release velocity estimation window as information available at release.

sources.title: Wide Open Spaces: A statistical technique for measuring space creation in professional soccer
supports: Distinction between occupying space for oneself and generating space for teammates.
Velocity-aware smooth influence surfaces.
Relative pitch-value model includes a trained feed-forward network.
Expert video validation rather than a universally available direct ground-truth label.
does_not_support: Claiming the whole method is training-free.
Identified causal effects from a fixed-defense route comparison.

sources.title: LaurieOnTracking / Metrica_PitchControl.py
sources.access_status: Full source file read through GitHub connector.
supports: Reaction extrapolation followed by immediate full-speed target travel.
Logistic arrival-time uncertainty and a control-rate accumulation.
Second-last-opponent plus ball/halfway offside line.
Ball travel time to a target followed by control integration.
does_not_support: Universal validity of the numeric default parameters.

sources.title: Laws of the Game: Law 11 — Offside
supports: Relevant teammate touch time, ordinary kick first contact and goalkeeper-throw last contact.
Opponent-half, ball and second-last-opponent conditions; level positions are onside.
Head/body/feet definition and exclusion of hands and arms.
Direct goal-kick, throw-in, corner exceptions.
Offside position by itself is not an offence.
does_not_support: A fixed 0.2 metre legal offside tolerance.

sources.title: Microsoft Premier League Hackathon Official Rules
sources.access_status: Official repository listing and full rules file read through GitHub connector.
supports: The year is explicitly 2026.
Football-realistic synthetic data is required; organizer footage is not distributed.
Video auto-eventing appears among features to consider.
Public GitHub, under-two-minute functional demo, working test access, English or translations.
Five equally weighted judging criteria; teams up to four.
does_not_support: Calling arbitrary video reconstruction a mandatory first development step.
Assuming a project can join after registration has closed.

sources.title: Hear the Game — Data: synthetic, but calibrated on real football
sources.access_status: Full data documentation read through GitHub connector.
supports: A seeded event generator calibrated from real-data aggregates, with synthetic runtime data.
Ball-only 10 Hz tracking, physical aggregates and hidden injected scenario labels.
does_not_support: Independent reproduction of the reference's claimed statistical performance.

sources.title: Hear the Game — synthetic generator
sources.access_status: Full source file retrieved; output construction and generating methods inspected.
supports: ball_track returns only t,x,y,in_play,team,period for the ball.
physical returns per-player per-minute aggregate statistics, not positions.
save writes meta, events, ball, physical and truth artifacts.
does_not_support: Tracking-based marking, lane geometry, or off-ball routes without additional synthetic player trajectories.

sources.title: Hear the Game — Foundry narrator
supports: Prepared facts are supplied to a structured-output narrator.
Numerical computation can be separated from language generation.
does_not_support: This file implementing a model-selected analysis function/tool loop.
Independent execution or benchmarking of the reference service.

checks: Closed-form minimum no larger than dense-grid minimum.
Every grid gap is within the stated Lipschitz bound.

limits: Does not apply unchanged to capture-radius, drag or bounded-acceleration models.
